description: Display-only categories. The five events_*.json files are real open Kalshi events recorded 2026-10-10T18:49Z from the public market data API with curl, unchanged (KXCPIYOY and KXPAYROLLS: Economics; KXNFLGAME and KXMLBGAME: Sports; KXTRUMPAPPROVE: Politics). The two Fed routes reuse the SYNTHETIC files of ../synthetic (one same and one opposite pair with polymarket/categories), so a match run over this scenario has a Fed pair present. KXBROKEN answers HTTP 500 to show that a failed display series is a skip, not a failed run.
